excerpt:
The Bundle Live at SPORTEL featuring Murray Barnett Louisa Clark Glen Killane Peter Bellamy on F1 and Apple, Relevent's global package, Ligue1 lessons, free to air in the YouTube era. 

Search Unofficial Partner where you get your podcasts. 
 
Themes:

The psychology of legacy partners matters: "Once you walk away from ESPN, Canal+, or Sky, they don't come back. This fundamentally changes risk calculations."

Platform promises vs. reality: "The gap between streaming platforms as "stalking horses" in negotiations and their actual commitment to sports continues to widen."

One size doesn't fit all: "Premium properties have options. Everyone else navigates between maintaining D2C control, going where audiences are, and taking whatever money is available."

Technology infrastructure is destiny: "Rights alone aren't enough; distribution and engagement technology increasingly determine what's possible."

When is the conservative play the smart move: "In a fragmented, uncertain market, grabbing increases and sticking with known partners may trump bold platform experiments."
author: Unofficial Partner
